flash_694820.description:
Hundreds of haredi protesters gathered overnight outside the home of a draft evader in Modi’in to protest his arrest.

The protesters attempted to break into the draft evader's apartment building. Following clashes between the protesters and police at the scene, the draft evader was released.

flash_694819.description: Saudi-led forces launch an operation in Yemen as government troops battle the Iran-backed Houthis, who claim missile and drone attacks on Saudi targets.

flash_694818.description:
A 35-year-old man was moderately injured while riding an electric scooter on Dizengoff Street in Tel Aviv.

Magen David Adom (MDA) teams provided him with medical treatment before evacuating him to Ichilov Hospital in the city.

flash_694816.description: Watch the special broadcast from Kan 11: Chilling footage from Soroka Hospital on October 7th revealed for the first time, alongside the heroic battle of the medical staff to save lives.

flash_694834.description: The Gaza Division's intelligence officer on the morning of the October 7th massacre has filed a series of objections to the IDF assigning him personal blame for the Hamas invasion.

flash_694833.description: Father and 13-year-old son injured in vehicle explosion in Jerusalem; incident believed criminal.

flash_694831.description: Extremist haredim clash with police during attempted arrest of haredi draft-evader; officers evacuated.

flash_694829.description: Rep. Rashida Tlaib urges Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer to stop an Israeli defense company from opening a $5 million facility in Sterling Heights.

flash_694827.description: Samoa's Prime Minister apologizes after a 2007 video emerged showing him performing a Nazi salute and leading a “Heil Hitler" chant at a family event.

flash_694825.description: President Trump approves the military execution of Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people at Fort Hood in 2009. The Army will determine the time and place.

flash_694823.description: US Central Command says forces have redirected 130 vessels enforcing the naval blockade against Iran and disabled three ships that refused to comply.

flash_694821.description: President Trump says the US is defeating Iran and predicts the war will end quickly, reiterating that Iran will not be allowed to have nuclear weapons.

flash_694817.description: A Channel 12 News poll gives Ofer Winter’s Amcha Yisrael party just 1.5%. The coalition bloc wins 49 seats, compared with 54 for the opposition.

flash_694815.description: President Trump confirms the US removed bombers from RAF Fairford over a threat, says he believes Iran was behind the attempted Flydubai attack.

flash_694855.description: Dozens of families from the Gevurah and Din V’Tzedek Forums demand an investigation of October 7 failure, accountability for those responsible, and lessons to be learned.

flash_694854.description: Flydubai is considering extending the suspension of its flights to Israel

flash_694853.description: MEP Rima Hassan removed an Israeli flag from an exhibition commemorating the victims of October 7. The incident is under investigation, and serious measures against her are reportedly being considered.

flash_694852.description: Finance Minister asks High Court to overturn Gali Baharav-Miara’s directive delaying the tender for 1,234 housing units in E1: “She is abusing the power of her office."

flash_694851.description: Former Biden administration Middle East envoy says neither the US nor Israel had an intelligence warning ahead of the October 7 attack.

flash_694849.description: August Hanning, 80, who served as head of Germany’s Federal Intelligence Service until 2005, is suspected of acting as an agent for a foreign intelligence service.

flash_694847.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu says Hamas may try to attack Israel ahead of elections to influence vote, warns Israel prepared to thwart such attempts, respond with 'tremendous force.'

flash_694845.description: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces capture strategic port city of Mokha, after Houthi attacks Jazan and Najran airports, causing injuries and damage.

flash_694843.description: MK Yaakov Asher warns demographic growth in haredi community must be reflected at polls, amid anger over the draft crisis and competition from new haredi parties.

flash_694841.description: 'Together' chair Naftali Bennett calls for bill targeting anyone who evaded IDF service or encourages draft evasion; Shas threatens legislation targeting Bennett himself.

flash_694839.description: IDF troops operating east of Yellow Line destroy 1.5-kilometer underground terror tunnel as operations against Hamas infrastructure in northern Gaza continue.

flash_694837.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz orders IDF to heighten readiness in Gaza following intelligence that Hamas may attempt attacks against Israeli forces.

flash_694835.description: Ofer Winter’s Amcha Yisrael party open to possibility of joining center-left government if key demands not met, candidate Eran Ben-Ari says.

flash_694832.description: Initial report: Two injured after car explodes in Jerusalem

flash_694830.description: Former Columbia professor Mohamed Abdou, who expressed support for Hamas, Hezbollah and Islamic Jihad after October 7, will address Berkeley students a day before the anniversary of the massacre.

flash_694828.description: New York Times reports Iranian drone plot targeting B-1 bombers and US personnel at RAF Fairford prompted the weekend withdrawal.

flash_694826.description: Bereaved families criticize Eyal Zamir for stating the IDF failed on October 7: “The soldiers who fought the enemy with their own bodies are not the failure."

flash_694872.description: Shin Bet chief David Zini warned of 'very concerning' attempts to establish 'quasi-military' frameworks in the Bedouin sector.

flash_694871.description: Extraordinary royal visit to Binyamin: King of the Warri Kingdom of Nigeria tours Psagot Winery and ancient Shiloh as Binyamin works to expand ties with African leaders.

flash_694870.description: Southern Command chief issues warning to Hamas at ceremony in Eshkol: “Any attempt to attack IDF soldiers or residents of the Negev will be met with a sharp response."

flash_694869.description: Terrorists from al-Mughayyir poisoned a livestock trough near Alon Road, affecting 50 sheep, killing nine and a shepherding dog as security forces launched searches.

flash_694868.description: Police attempted to stop a motorcyclist for inspection in Lod. He allegedly fled, struck an officer and lightly injured him.

flash_694867.description: A pathologist in Namibia recognized ZAKA volunteer Yossi Landau from a deadly plane crash 19 years ago and agreed to release an Israeli traveler’s body without an autopsy.

flash_694866.description: A complaint accuses the comedian of “demonising" and “dehumanising" Muslims. Cleese’s response? “I can’t wait to be arrested."

flash_694865.description: Rima Hassan faces backlash over removing an Israeli flag from an October 7 memorial exhibition. France’s Foreign Minister said the allegations, if true, warrant EU sanctions.

flash_694864.description: IDF Chief of Staff, Police Commissioner, and Shin Bet chief hold multi-front situation assessment and agree on a series of measures aimed at ensuring the elections are held safely and without disruption.

flash_694863.description: Since the beginning of the year, more than 1,200 foreign airline crew members from countries without diplomatic ties with Israel, including Syria, Lebanon, and Oman, have entered the country.

flash_694862.description: This Friday: brunch and site tour in Givat HaMatos with Rabbi Kalman Topp. Explore the new neighborhood and hear the vision behind the new Anglo community, Ahavat Yisrael.

flash_694861.description: President Isaac Herzog will present Israel’s highest civilian award for heroism this week to six Israelis who acted to save the passengers of the Dubai-Tel Aviv flight.

flash_694860.description: Nova security chief sues Ronen Bar for NIS 2.5 million, alleging he failed to pass on critical warnings that could have saved lives on October 7, 'He did not pass on vital information, he is responsible for this massacre.'

flash_694859.description: President Trump approves execution by firing squad of Nidal Hasan, who murdered 13 people and wounded 32 others in Fort Hood, Texas in 2009, in the first execution carried out by the US military since 1961.

flash_694858.description: Captivity survivor Bar Kuperstein returned to the Nova festival site from which he was abducted, put on tefillin in memory of those murdered, and called on the public to join him.

flash_694857.description: Shin Bet chief's father blasts Simchat Torah memorial day: 'No value whatsoever in this unfortunate decision'

flash_694856.description: Ahead of the third anniversary of the massacre, the National Security Council warns of an increased risk of attempted attacks against Israelis and Jews abroad and calls for heightened vigilance.

flash_694850.description: US court allows lawsuit filed by US victims of October 7 massacre against businessman Bashar al-Masri, alleging that Masri provided assistance to Hamas, to proceed.

flash_694848.description: Initial report: Police officer lightly injured in Lod ramming, forces pursuing suspect

flash_694846.description: Foreign Minister Gideon Sa’ar warns international political, legal and economic pressure aims to force Israel to establish Palestinian state that would threaten Israel's very existence.

flash_694844.description: Thousands of users received a shocking notification claiming hackers had breached ASOS systems and were threatening to leak data - sent on the company's own app.

flash_694878.description: Texas Governor Greg Abbott orders US and Texas flags lowered to half-staff to honor the victims of Hamas’ October 7 massacre, on the third anniversary of the attack.

flash_694877.description: Israel’s UN mission marks three years since October 7 with Eliya Cohen and Ziv Abud sharing their story as US envoy Mike Waltz vows it won’t happen again.

flash_694876.description:
Arab channels report that IDF forces detonated an explosive device in the eastern part of the Tuffah neighborhood in Gaza City. Columns of smoke were seen in the area following the explosion.

It was also reported that Israeli fighter jets are flying at low altitude over the Gaza Strip and releasing flares.

flash_694874.description: President Trump predicts the Iran war will end “pretty soon", adding: “They’re not a bully anymore."

flash_694889.description: President Isaac Herzog and his wife, Michal, open Israel’s October 7 memorial events by lighting a candle at 6:29 a.m. at the President’s Residence.

flash_694888.description: IDF data reveals the scale of three years of fighting and sweeping reforms in intelligence, border defense, reserves and military readiness.

flash_694887.description: Hamas attack on Israel started at this time three years ago

flash_694885.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Bezalel Smotrich will meet with rabbis in Jerusalem on Thursday as efforts intensify to consolidate the right-wing bloc ahead of elections.

flash_694883.description: Page Six reports that Sydney Sweeney is considering converting to Judaism amid her relationship with Jewish music producer Scooter Braun.

flash_694881.description:
Swedish police shot an armed man outside the Royal Palace in the capital, Stockholm.

Police said officers were called to the scene following reports of “a person causing a disturbance and armed with a weapon."

flash_694879.description:
A man in his 40s was injured overnight in a violent incident in Givat Chen.

Magen David Adom (MDA) teams provided him with medical treatment and evacuated him to Meir Hospital in serious condition.

flash_694875.description: Recent satellite images indicate a major resumption of activity at Minzadei, a nuclear weapons development site in Iran that was struck by Israel.

flash_694873.description: Labor Court approves class action against Rami Levy over allegations that the supermarket chain deducted cash register shortages from cashiers’ salaries.

flash_694907.description: Shelters where Israelis fought for survival during the October 7 massacre are set to receive legal protection as national heritage sites.

flash_694906.description: The Israel Prison Service launched a major preemptive operation at five security detention facilities at exactly the minute that the October 7th massacre began.

flash_694904.description: Hebron yeshiva student from prominent haredi family arrested in Eilat after police find him in apartment linked to known drug offender.

flash_694902.description: A chilling message claiming recipients viewed illegal material is circulating in Israel.

flash_694900.description: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee made a formal statement renewing the USA's commitment to standing with Israel on the anniversary of the October 7th massacre.

flash_694898.description: Police examining conduct of two senior Transportation Ministry officials following attempted Flydubai hijacking.

flash_694896.description: Samaria terror attack leaves 25-year-old man moderately injured, four others lightly injured.

flash_694894.description: Mali and Liel Yahalomi, reported missing during a stay in Vienna two months ago, arrested in Namibia on suspicion of possessing forged passports.

flash_694892.description: Marking three years since the massacre at 6:29 a.m., National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir warns of a possible infiltration from Judea and Samaria and calls for the Palestinian Authority to be disarmed.

flash_694890.description: Yosef Haim Ohana, held in Gaza for 738 days, releases footage of the first moments of his abduction and reflects on captivity, survival, and reclaiming control of his life.

flash_694886.description: New NYPD data shows 53% of confirmed New York City hate crimes this year targeted Jews, who make up about 10% of the population

flash_694884.description: Israeli Consul General Ofir Akunis invites NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani to view IDF footage of the October 7 Hamas massacre amid Mamdani’s ongoing criticism of Israel.

flash_694880.description: US Vice President says Iran must significantly reduce its nuclear enrichment capacity for a deal to end the war.

flash_694937.description:
A short while ago, an interceptor was launched toward a false target identified in the area in which IDF soldiers are operating in southern Lebanon.

No sirens were sounded in accordance with protocol.

flash_694936.description: Captivity survivor Eli Sharabi and actress Shani Cohen host the October 7th Families memorial ceremony at Park Hayarkon, marking three years since the massacre.

flash_694935.description: The pro-Hamas protests on the anniversary of October 7 prove why Jews still need a safe haven.

flash_694933.description: Menachem Kalmanson tearfully recalled how his brother Elhanan was shot while rescuing residents of Kibbutz Be’eri after hours of lifesaving missions.

flash_694931.description: Israeli, US, and Jewish officials condemned NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s statement marking the third anniversary of the October 7 massacre.

flash_694929.description: Three years after the massacre, the Knesset Constitution Committee presses for implementation of the law to prosecute Nukhba terrorists, with lawmakers demanding action and answers for the victims’ families.

flash_694927.description:
Israel’s Ambassador to the United States, Yechiel Leiter, provided an update on the condition of his son Neria, who was critically wounded in a ramming attack.

“Neria has severe head injuries, but in recent days he has begun breathing on his own. He is still unconscious."

flash_694925.description:
According to a Reuters report, Hezbollah received $200 million from Iran that was earmarked for displaced Lebanese, marking the first such aid since the start of the war.

The funds intended for Hezbollah were transferred through intermediaries, who charged fees four times higher than usual due to the increased risk.

flash_694923.description: More than 75 retired US generals, admirals, and military lawyers say the facts and legal standard do not support accusations of genocide in Gaza.

flash_694921.description: Israel advocate Yoseph Haddad confronted thousands of demonstrators in London and shouted: “On October 7, 1,200 Israelis, Arabs and Jews, were murdered together."

flash_694917.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani claims to mourn Israelis murdered and abducted on October 7 before accusing Israel of committing “war crimes" in Gaza and condemning continued US military support.

flash_694915.description: Thousands visited the site of the Nova Festival, where hundreds of civilians and security forces were murdered during the October 7th Massacre.

flash_694913.description: A police source said that Mali and Liel Yahalomi boarded an Israir flight from Athens to Israel and are expected to land in the country within the next half hour.

flash_694911.description: Former hostage Eitan Mor says Hamas filmed him dozens of times but never released the footage, praises father Tzvika Mor for opposing a hostage deal 'at any cost.'

flash_694909.description: On October 7, 2023, ordinary women found themselves facing extraordinary circumstances as thousands of Hamas terrorists invaded Israel from Gaza with the purpose of killing and kidnapping as many people as possible.

flash_694949.description: Israeli Ambassador Yechiel Leiter sharply criticizes NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani over his October 7 anniversary statement accusing Israel of genocide in Gaza.

flash_694948.description:
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that a tanker was struck by multiple projectiles in waters north of Qatar, resulting in casualties.

According to the agency, the attack occurred approximately 94 kilometers north of the Qatari city of Madinat ash Shamal.

flash_694946.description: President Trump marks three years since the October 7 massacre, honoring the victims and survivors and vowing to always stand against terror and evil.

flash_694944.description: The White House has asked the Pentagon for options to strike Iran before the midterms as Trump seeks progress in the war and lower gas prices, according to The Atlantic.

flash_694942.description: Rabbi Benny Kalmanson, whose son Elhanan fell while rescuing residents of Be’eri, recited Kaddish and called for unity and mutual responsibility.

flash_694940.description: Channel 13 gives Netanyahu’s bloc 55 seats, while a separate Channel 14 poll gives the bloc 63 seats, with Likud leading at 31 in the latter survey.

flash_694938.description: Hezbollah activity has been identified in three areas of southern Lebanon from which the IDF is expected to withdraw under the agreements with Lebanon.

flash_694934.description:
The White House issued a statement commemorating the anniversary of the October 7th Massacre.

"The Trump Administration remains committed to confronting terrorism and bringing hostages home. America will always stand as a beacon of freedom, defending our allies and values around the world," the White House stated.

flash_694932.description: Marking three years since the October 7 massacre, President Isaac Herzog addresses memorial ceremony at Nova Festival site in Re’im.

flash_694928.description: Following efforts by the Golani Training Base rabbi, it was decided to allow Hesder soldiers to leave in an orderly manner before the women’s singing at the ceremony.

flash_694926.description: Reuters reports Iran sent Hezbollah $200 million for displaced Lebanese families, despite tighter US pressure and growing obstacles to moving funds.

flash_694924.description: After disappearing in Vienna, being found in Argentina and falsely linked to arrests in Namibia, Mali and Liel Yahalomi are returning to Israel.

flash_694922.description: Israeli Ambassador to the UN Danny Danon said in response to New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's statement on October 7: “'Mamdani-ism' - an attempt to hijack the anniversary of October 7 and turn it into yet another propaganda attack against Israel. It is like turning September 11 into a day of mourning for al-Qaeda terrorists. We will not let this happen. We will remember those who were murdered, and we will never forget who was behind this massacre."

flash_694920.description: After disappearing in Vienna, being found in Argentina and falsely linked to arrests in Namibia, Mali and Liel Yahalomi are returning to Israel.

flash_694961.description: Pentagon instructed US Central Command to complete preparations for renewed military operations against Iran, potentually before Israel's elections, report says.

flash_694960.description: When a US trust becomes a cross-border problem-and what to do about it.

flash_694959.description: Toronto police are investigating after Israeli flags were burned outside a North York church on October 7, prompting condemnation from Jewish leaders.

flash_694957.description: Pro-Palestinian Arab activists in Jordan are urging a boycott of Andrea Bocelli's Petra concert, citing his support for Israel.

flash_694955.description: At the national memorial ceremony, Adi Marciano delivers a poignant tribute to her daughter, IDF lookout Noa Marciano, who was abducted alive on October 7 and murdered in Hamas captivity.

flash_694953.description: Marking three years since the October 7 massacre, Dror Tzfati makes his first memorial visit to the Nova festival site near Re'im, where his son spent his final hours.

flash_694951.description: New York prosecutors are expected to charge Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores over the alleged torture of Americans held in Venezuelan prisons.

flash_694947.description: Omri Shifroni, who lost family members in the massacre at Kibbutz Be’eri, speaks at national memorial ceremony and calls for a thorough investigation to uncover the truth and restore public trust.

flash_694945.description: An 18-year-old Minnesota man allegedly pledged allegiance to ISIS and planned a mass shooting at the Mall of America because he believed it was Jewish-owned, federal charges say.

flash_694943.description: A century-old debate over shepherding in the Land of Israel takes on new meaning as modern farms combine agriculture, security, and settlement in defending Jewish control of the land.

flash_694941.description:
US President Donald Trump said that he spoke with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, marking the third anniversary of the October 7th Massacre.

"I spoke with Bibi Netanyahu and I wished him well and I wished the people of Israel well. That was a horrible day, a horrible tragedy - and the other side is paying a very big price for what they did on October 7th, believe me."

flash_694939.description: Israel’s Ambassador to the United States, Yechiel Leiter, clarified that despite several encouraging signs, Neria remains in very serious condition and is not yet out of danger. Leiter noted that "the medical treatment he is receiving in the intensive care unit at Shaare Zedek Medical Center is of the highest standard." The Leiter family thanked the medical staff and the public for their prayers and support, and asked that people continue to pray for the recovery of Neria Dov ben Chana.

flash_694982.description: Reservists chief Yoaz Hendel calls on Amcha Yisrael chair Ofer Winter to form political alliance, pledge to join only a Zionist government not dependent on haredi or Arab parties.

flash_694981.description: Six days before the Chief Rabbinate's certification exams, the ITIM organization petitions the High Court to ensure that women can take the tests.

flash_694980.description: Three years after Oct. 7, JFNA says Jewish engagement has reached an elevated ‘new normal.’

flash_694978.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu meets Paraguayan Vice President Pedro Alliana to discuss stronger bilateral ties, thanks Paraguay for steadfast support of Israel throughout war.

flash_694976.description: The State Attorney's Office has filed an indictment against Muhammad Shalabi of Beit Hanina, alleging that he planned to attack security forces and Jewish civilians using explosives and poisons.

flash_694974.description: Police complete investigation into 52-year-old Old City resident suspected of deliberately setting fire to a sukkah in central Jerusalem due to racist motives.

flash_694972.description: Military Police forced to withdraw without making arrests in Dimona, Bat Yam, after dozens of haredi protesters physically blocked arrest operations targeting draft evaders.

flash_694970.description: Jerusalem Faction announces mass demonstrations protesting arrests of yeshiva students; major traffic disruptions expected in Jerusalem and central Israel.

flash_694968.description: Israel receives first fully US-made Iron Dome interceptor from a new Raytheon-Rafael facility in Arkansas, marking milestone in US-Israel defense cooperation.

flash_694966.description: British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband announces that the British Consulate General in Jerusalem will remain open under a new name following talks with Israel,

flash_694964.description: Sa'ar: British Consulate in Jerusalem will be closed, 20 diplomats will be expelled

flash_694962.description: Three years after October 7, the IDF is overhauling its observation unit: Operations rooms will be moved farther from the border or fortified..

flash_694958.description:
New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani did not attend a screening of footage documenting the atrocities committed by Hamas during the October 7 massacre, despite receiving an official invitation from Israel’s Consul General in New York, Ofir Akunis.

Following Mamdani’s absence, Akunis posted a photo on social of the empty seat reserved for the mayor, writing: “Guess who didn't show up?"

flash_694956.description: Former hostage Itay Regev recalls being shot on October 7, his farewell call with his father, and the moment a terrorist held a gun to his head.

flash_695007.description: Capt. Eliav Haim Tzapalamus, 21, from Haifa, was killed during operational activity in southern Lebanon when the Humvee he was traveling in overturned. Three other soldiers were lightly wounded.

flash_695006.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu received an unexpected birthday surprise Thursday evening when hundreds of local officials, activists and public representatives broke into song to celebrate his 77th birthday.

flash_695005.description:
In the incident in which Captain Eliav Haim Tzapalamus fell, three IDF soldiers were lightly injured.

The soldiers were evacuated to receive medical treatment at a hospital, and their families have been notified.

flash_695003.description: 'The price should be that Gaza, that was always part of the Jewish Land, Eretz Israel, should be given back to the Jews. This is justice', says Zehut party chairman Moshe Feiglin on i24NEWS's new show, offering to relocate Gazans to Somaliland

flash_695001.description: Shas claims draft-evasion arrests are politically motivated to weaken the right-wing bloc.

flash_694999.description: A Haredi battalion broke into song and dance after swearing into the IDF at the Western Wall - while protests against the draft were underway elsewhere in Jerusalem.

flash_694997.description: Yemen’s Houthis claim they launched two missiles at the airport in Saudi Arabia’s capital, Riyadh.

flash_694995.description: The Transportation Ministry’s Aviation Security Operations Center has issued new guidelines requiring foreign airlines to verify the citizenship of all crew members on every flight to Israel or any flight passing through Israeli airspace.

flash_694993.description: Central District police commander wounded on October 7 to retire after 38 years of service, 'I will carry the fallen in my heart forever.'

flash_694991.description:
Police began dispersing protesters in Jerusalem after hundreds of demonstrators blocked roads, violently confronted drivers, and damaged vehicles, according to police.

Read more

flash_694989.description:
Hundreds of haredi protesters are blocking the entrance to Jerusalem near the Chords Bridge. At the same time, dozens of protesters have gathered on Bar-Ilan Street, disrupting traffic in the area.

Police said additional forces have been called to the area and are prepared to clear the roads if necessary. Traffic police are directing drivers to alternate routes, and the public is urged to avoid the area and follow police instructions.

Read more

flash_694987.description: Consumers are urged not to eat affected containers of Ben & Jerry’s Milk & Honey ice cream following a complaint about a foreign object resembling plastic.

flash_694985.description: President Isaac Herzog presents the Medal of Civilian Heroism to six Israelis who subdued the terrorist and saved the passengers aboard the Flydubai flight.

flash_694979.description: Ahead of the elections, Tzohar Rabbinical Organization chairman Rabbi David Stav says rabbis are entitled to express political opinions, but should not present them as binding halachic rulings.

flash_695017.description: Ofer Winter receives a warm reception in Bnei Brak before being confronted by extremist haredi protesters from the Jerusalem Faction, who shout insults at him.

flash_695016.description:
Three people were injured when an all-terrain vehicle overturned near Al-Eizariya.

Magen David Adom (MDA) teams evacuated a man in his 30s to Hadassah Mount Scopus Hospital in serious condition, along with another man in his 30s who was moderately injured. A 15-year-old boy was evacuated to Shaare Zedek Hospital in serious condition.

flash_695014.description: On the third anniversary of October 7th, Zach and Montana Tucker put deniers in VR headsets to watch the footage from that day, then bring out two survivors who were there.

flash_695012.description: Former military secretary Avi Gil recounts the dramatic hours leading up to October 7, including the initial 3:55 a.m. alert, his 6:29 a.m. call to Netanyahu, and an alleged attempt to alter official records.

flash_695010.description:
A man in his 30s was killed in a vehicle explosion on Highway 4, near the Pal-Yam Junction at the entrance to Or Akiva.

According to the police he was a known criminal figure.

flash_695008.description:
Maj. Gen. (res.) Avi Gil, who served as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s military secretary during the October 7 massacre, claimed in an interview with Channel 12 News that Tzachi Braverman instructed a stenographer to change the time of a phone call held on the morning of the attack from 6:40 a.m. to 6:29 a.m.

According to Gil, the stenographer refused to make the change, and he informed the Attorney General’s legal adviser. Gil described the act as “forgery" and added: “Changing a transcript means changing the truth."

flash_695004.description: Three years after Hamas’ massacre, Staff Sgt. Maj. Rami Cohen returns to the Sderot police station, where he rescued two little girls hiding beside their murdered mother before being shot 14 times and left wounded for two hours.

flash_695002.description: Magen David Adom paramedics pronounced the death of a woman in her 40s who was struck by a vehicle on Route 85 in the Lower Galilee, near the Bar-Lev Industrial Zone.

flash_695000.description: US President Donald Trump announced that he will not attack Iran before the midterm elections on November 3. He said talks with Tehran are making progress and that the blockade will continue.

flash_694998.description: The IDF eliminated two Hamas terrorists in Gaza who were involved in holding hostages and advancing attacks against Israeli troops and civilians, saying both violated the ceasefire.

flash_694996.description:
Police announced that the roads at the entrance to Jerusalem have reopened to traffic after protesters left the area.

Jerusalem District Police and Border Police officers continue to operate in the area to maintain public order and ensure the flow of traffic.

flash_694994.description: National Public Diplomacy Directorate chief Tzipi Hotovely honors the creators of NAZA - The True Story, which has drawn tens of millions of views worldwide.

flash_694992.description: Anti-draft protests escalate into riots, vehicle attacks, and Highway 4 roadblocks, with protesters calling police 'Nazis.' Police Commissioner Danny Levy ordered decisive action and warned of arrests.

flash_694990.description: The ISA has revealed a series of terrorism investigations involving residents of Israel’s southern Negev region.

flash_694988.description:
A number of right-wing organizations have called on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to order the closure of France’s Consulate General in Jerusalem, following the closure of the British Consulate in the city this morning and the departure of 20 British diplomats from Israel.

In a letter signed by the heads of several organizations, including the Sovereignty Movement, Regavim, My Israel, Ad Kan, Artzenu and the Kohelet Policy Forum, the groups called for France and Britain to be treated equally in light of what they described as anti-Israel actions.
